2607.26023.title: CHARM: A Multimodal Graph Foundation Model with Hierarchical Context Modeling for Zero-Shot Transfer
2607.26023.paper_summary: Graph foundation models (GFMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for transferring knowledge across graph domains and tasks. Real-world graphs associate nodes with text, images, and other modalities, making multimodal graphs essential for representing complex entities and relations. Moreover, collecting labels and adapting models for every new graph domain is costly and often infeasible, motivating zero-shot transfer. Unfortunately, zero-shot transfer on multimodal graphs remains underexplored. Existing GNN-based graph foundation models typically require downstream adaptation, whereas LLM-based graph methods mainly address unimodal graphs or tasks within a single domain. This setting presents two key challenges. First, models must generalize knowledge from individual modalities while capturing transferable cross-modal relations. Second, without target-domain fine-tuning, node representations remain entangled with domain-specific structures and modality-specific characteristics, obscuring shared concepts in unseen domains. To address these challenges, we propose CHARM, a multimodal graph foundation model with hierarchical context modeling for zero-shot transfer. CHARM replaces isolated raw nodes with hierarchical graph contexts that capture multimodal semantics and cross-modal relations. These contexts map domain-specific node patterns to shared high-level concepts, reducing reliance on target-domain supervision or adaptation. A modality-aware graph context encoder integrates multimodal information with graph structure and converts the resulting representations into graph tokens for a large language model . Experiments show consistent improvements on zero-shot multimodal graph tasks.
2607.26023.paper_summary_zh: 圖形基礎模型（GFMs）已成為跨圖形領域和任務轉移知識的有前景的範式。現實世界的圖形將節點與文本、圖像和其他模態相關聯，使得多模態圖形對於表示複雜實體和關係至關重要。此外，為每個新的圖形領域收集標籤和調整模型的成本高昂且往往不可行，這促使了零樣本轉移。不幸的是，在多模態圖形上進行零樣本轉移仍然未被充分探索。現有的基於GNN的圖形基礎模型通常需要下游適應，而基於LLM的圖形方法主要針對單一模態的圖形或單一領域內的任務。這種情況帶來了兩個主要挑戰。首先，模型必須從個別模態中概括知識，同時捕捉可轉移的跨模態關係。其次，在沒有目標領域微調的情況下，節點表示仍然與特定於領域的結構和特定於模態的特徵交織在一起，模糊了在未見領域中的共享概念。為了解決這些挑戰，我們提出了CHARM，一種具有層次上下文建模的多模態圖形基礎模型，用於零樣本轉移。CHARM用層次圖形上下文替換孤立的原始節點，這些上下文捕捉多模態語義和跨模態關係。這些上下文將特定於領域的節點模式映射到共享的高級概念，減少對目標領域監督或適應的依賴。一個模態感知的圖形上下文編碼器將多模態信息與圖形結構整合，並將生成的表示轉換為大型語言模型的圖形標記。實驗顯示在零樣本多模態圖形任務上有一致的改進。
